use_case: UC1 - Air quality and traffic: can we explain poor-air days and warn clinic patients in time? (Valdena Civic Health Office, IT; as-of 2026-10-15)
objective_summary: Decide whether the Health Office can prototype a day-ahead poor-air warning method now, using public hourly air-quality data for 2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04, and whether its own station, traffic and daily clinic count data for 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31 is complete enough at the needed grain for the live model. The discovery must also name unusable data and the red flags to resolve before profiling.

need_plans.interpretation: Hourly concentrations of NO2 and/or PM2.5 (ideally also PM10, O3) from urban or traffic monitoring stations in an Italian city, covering the prototype window (2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04) and the production window (2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31) at hourly or finer grain, with station id, pollutant, unit and validation flag.
internal_queries: hourly air quality station readings NO2 PM2.5
wiki: Valdena station data request status
external_data_hints: Italian regional environmental agency (ARPA) or national ISPRA open-data portal publishing hourly validated station data for an urban area in northern Italy, covering 2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04 for the prototype; check the publisher's licence and that the station list includes traffic-type and background-type sites. Trap: many portals only offer data from around 2010 onward; a 2004-2005 gap must be confirmed, not assumed.

European Environment Agency (EEA) Air Quality e-Reporting or Air Quality Download Service for Italian station hourly data, if the regional portal lacks 2004-2005. Trap: EEA annual aggregates are not hourly.
acceptance_criteria: Hourly or finer grain with timestamps in a stated time zone (UTC or Europe/Rome, DST handled)
Covers 2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04 with no gap longer than a few hours for at least one urban station (prototype)
Pollutant NO2 or PM2.5 present with unit stated (µg/m3)
Station metadata (location, type traffic/background) available to join with N2
Licence readable at source and permits prototyping (open-data policy)
Production window coverage checked separately from the city's own station data
likely_pitfalls: Station ids renamed or migrated between agencies and years
Mixed units or reference-method changes (gravimetric vs beta-attenuation PM2.5)
Provisional vs validated data; latest months not yet validated
Daylight-saving or UTC offsets misaligning hourly rows
Missing hours recorded as zero rather than null
Register holds no air-quality source; the only vendor feed is expired

need_plans.interpretation: Hourly vehicle counts or traffic volume on roads near the monitoring stations for the production window (2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31), joinable to station ids.
internal_queries: wiki: traffic feed owner and licence
external_data_hints: City or metropolitan-area open-data portal publishing hourly vehicle counts from road loop or camera sensors, 2024-2025, with sensor location linked to air-monitor sites. Trap: counts per lane versus per direction, and sensors with gaps or outages.
acceptance_criteria: Hourly grain for every sensor used, covering 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31
Each traffic sensor has coordinates so distance to each air station can be stated (within a justified radius)
Units (vehicles per hour, per direction) documented
Licence and owner recorded; unknown stays unknown
Outage rate per sensor reported
likely_pitfalls: Sensor replacement creates a break in the series
Counts from one lane or direction mistaken for total flow
Holiday and lockdown-period distortions not flagged
No public traffic source is in the register

need_plans.interpretation: Hourly air temperature and relative humidity for the city area, prototype window 2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04 and production window 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31.
internal_queries: wiki: weather feed AtmosData expired contract
external_data_hints: National or regional meteorological service (for example ARPA meteo network or the national weather service open data) with hourly station observations for the same city, 2004-2005 and 2024-2025. Trap: stations with precipitation only, or gaps in older years.
acceptance_criteria: Hourly temperature_2m and relative humidity for both windows, for the chosen coordinates
Open-Meteo reanalysis is a model product: state that it is not station observation and record the coordinates as an assumption in decisions.md
Coordinates set in the Open-Meteo call per the brief (client city not named; do not use the Lisbon default)
AtmosData vendor feed is NOT usable: contract expired 2025-12-31, key revoked
Licence recorded (Open-Meteo terms)
likely_pitfalls: Reanalysis vs observed values differ, especially for humidity
Using the register's default Lisbon coordinates, which do not match Italy
Requesting too long a date range in one probe call
Time zone mismatch with air data (use UTC on both sides)

need_plans.interpretation: Daily counts of respiratory clinic visits by district for the production window (2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31). Aggregated only; no patient-level data.
internal_queries: respiratory clinic visits daily count district
wiki: clinic extract, district codes, data sharing agreement
external_data_hints: No external source expected; if the clinic extract is delayed, a regional health-service open dataset of respiratory outpatient counts by ASL/district could serve as context only. Trap: such datasets are usually monthly and not by clinic.
acceptance_criteria: Daily grain, counts by district, covering 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31 with no suppressed-zero artefacts
Only aggregated counts leave the clinic; small-cell suppression rule stated
District code system documented and joinable to a residence or area key
Data-sharing basis confirmed by the clinic (unknown until stated)
likely_pitfalls: Visit counts reflect clinic opening hours and staffing changes, not illness
District codes changed between years
Clinic system migration leaves a gap or duplicate visits
Patient-level fields slipping into the extract

need_plans.interpretation: Patient-level visit events for the clinic. Out of scope per brief; could only be considered if a lawful basis and minimisation are documented.
acceptance_criteria: Brief states individual patient records are out of scope; mark as not usable unless the Health Office and Legal explicitly reopen it
If reopened: lawful basis, pseudonymisation and consent documented before any access
likely_pitfalls: Identifiers leaking into the analysis set
Consent captured late or not for this purpose
Re-identification risk from small districts and dates

need_plans.interpretation: National yearly estimates of deaths attributable to PM2.5, for context only, covering the prototype period (around 2004-2005) and the production period (2024-2025), at annual grain, national level for Italy.
internal_queries: burden of disease air pollution Italy
external_data_hints: European Environment Agency or WHO/ISS (Istituto Superiore di Sanità) publications giving PM2.5 attributable deaths for Italy by year. Trap: EEA reports attributable deaths for recent years only and model estimates change between editions; record the edition and year used.
acceptance_criteria: Annual grain, national Italy
Both years 2004-2005 and 2024-2025 covered, or the gap stated
Edition/version and method recorded; estimates not presented as observed
Licence readable (open-data policy: context use allowed)
likely_pitfalls: Modelled estimates, not counts; revisions between editions
Different methodology (GBD vs EEA) gives different numbers
Used for context only, not as a model input

open_questions: Which city does the client serve? The brief says no source names it; the Open-Meteo default in the register (45.46, 9.19) is Milan, but the brief says the default is Lisbon. Confirm the coordinates and record them in decisions.md.
Has the city's own air-quality station data request been filed, and what is its expected date?
Who owns the traffic data and under what licence can it be used for production?
Does the clinic confirm a data-sharing basis for daily district counts (N4) and a small-cell suppression rule?
Is the AtmosData renewal (expired 2025-12-31) expected to be signed? The feed is not needed if Open-Meteo covers N3 for the prototype, but production may need station-grade weather.
Is a 2004-2005 hourly public station series confirmed to exist for an Italian city in the chosen region?
